hospitalization_proxy.meaning: Existing ILINet/FluSurv reconstructed, stitched training history through 2022-05-28, including the existing 728-day shift and historical preprocessing. Training only; never evaluation truth.

ilinet_normalized.meaning: ILINet unweighted ILI plus one transformed per location using the existing R bestNormalize preprocessing. Frozen transformed inputs, not raw ILI percentages; used only for optional historical ED reconstruction.
